objective.name: reading_cursor
objective.description: Defines how far one reader has read one conversation: the line of the journal of the lineage up to which the reader has read.

functional._reader_note: Required. Identifier of the reader (user:1 for the person using the interface).
functional._lineage_id_note: Required. Identifier of the lineage read: the first continuity of the conversation, the one a parent knows, whatever the generation.
functional._seq_note: Required. Number of the last line read (a non-negative integer). It only grows.
